title: Vacuum Lab: control software for thin-film vacuum chambers
description: Native Linux control and automation software for a magnetron sputter deposition rig. It drives a Pfeiffer TC 600 turbopump and a TPG 252 A gauge controller over serial, runs deposition recipes with safety interlocks, records every run in a database, serves a web control panel and turns an Android tablet into the lab's locked-down touch display.
